title: Rochester Sports & Recreation Complex Working Group to meet in March 2025
shortTitle: Rochester Sports & Recreation Complex Working Group to hold monthly meetings to be held March-May
summary: The City of Rochester, TSP, and Bolton & Menk have drafted a conceptual plan for the Rochester Sports and Recreation Complex (RSRC) featuring baseball/softball fields, multi-use rectangular fields, trails, and a playground for community and tournament use. They are forming a community Working Group to gather equitable local feedback and refine the final design.
author: Ed Hruska
